title: cc-review Reviewer Frontmatter
description: Metadata contract for a reviewer plugin (the YAML frontmatter of <name>.md or <name>/reviewer.md). Discovery (core/scripts/discover-reviewers.sh) enforces these rules with jq and the filesystem checks noted in each field's description. Unknown fields are ignored with a verbose-level note so the format can grow.

name.description: Stable identifier used for config keys (reviewers.<name>), derived CLI flags (--no-<name>), source_agent, and console rows. Must equal the file basename (without .md) or the plugin directory name. Must be a YAML string: quote a value YAML reads as a number or boolean ("007", "1e3"). Must not be one of the reserved names: external, fix, meta-review, only, sequential, parallel, pr, spec, hints, output, config, profile, max-rounds.

kind.description: prompt: the body is the reviewer prompt dispatched as a fresh-context subagent. command: the body holds parsing notes and the command fields describe an external tool.

display_name.description: Shown in the console summary and findings report.

category.description: Written to every finding's category field. Must be a YAML string (quote all-digit values).

enabled.description: Default enablement when the merged config has no reviewers.<name> key.

requires.description: Precondition tokens: pr (PR context available), spec (spec file provided), binary:<name> (executable on PATH). Unknown tokens are treated as unsatisfied and the reviewer is skipped.

severity_map.description: Native severity vocabulary to cc-review severity. Native values not in the map pass through unchanged when they are already cc-review severities; otherwise the finding is dropped with a warning.

dedup.description: isolated: findings from this reviewer never merge with findings of other categories during deduplication.

references.description: prompt only. Ordered relative paths inside the plugin directory, inlined after the prompt body under a '## Reference: <path>' heading. Absolute paths, '..' segments, and missing files make the reviewer invalid.

context.description: prompt only. Optional context blocks the core supplies at dispatch time. goals: the declared PR goals and linked issues, supplied only when PR context exists.

detect.description: command only, required. Shell check; exit 0 means the tool is available, otherwise the reviewer is skipped with reason 'not available'.

auth_check.description: command only, optional. Shell check; non-zero exit skips the reviewer with reason 'not authenticated' (plus the last line of its stderr). A project-layer command reviewer runs neither detect nor auth_check until it is trusted in ~/.cc-review/trusted-reviewers.

invoke.description: command only, required. Command template. Supported placeholders are exactly {base_branch}, {files} (space-separated shell-quoted changed file paths), and {pr_number}. Using {pr_number} without PR context skips the reviewer with reason 'requires: pr'.

timeout_seconds.description: command only. Wall-clock bound for the invoke command.

output.description: command only, required. How raw tool output becomes findings.

format.description: json: the tool prints a JSON array of findings (file, line or line_start, severity, description, rationale, optional fix and confidence). delimited: blocks separated by 'delimiter' with '<Label>: <value>' lines mapped by 'fields'. parser: a script in the plugin directory reads raw output on stdin and prints json format.

fields.description: Required for delimited. Finding field to the label the tool prints.

parser.description: Required for parser. Relative path inside the plugin directory; must be executable.
